subject: Scheduling: on‑prem ops & VPC architecture session for AcmeBio
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmebio.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@acmebio.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post‑discovery: proposing an on‑prem ops & VPC architecture session

Hi Samantha / Rajesh —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: AcmeBio wants a private deployment (VPC) with site isolation, strict key management, and predictable throughput for batch genomics inference. You mentioned an internal ops review and network/security checklist that we should align on before any POC.

Next step proposal: schedule a focused 60‑minute ops & architecture session where our infra engineer (Connor) and I walk through the proposed private deployment architecture, required network peering/firewall rules, and a short checklist your team can use to validate readiness.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Thu Jul 16: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Fri Jul 17: 09:00–10:00 or 13:00–14:00

If none of those work, please share a few slots that suit your ops team. Pre‑call asks (attached checklist + short items):
- Share VPC CIDR ranges and whether you require NAT/proxy egress filtering
- Confirm KMS provider (AWS KMS / HSM) and any compliance constraints
- List of IPs/CIDR blocks we should expect to add for the initial POC

I attached our discovery notes and a short prereq checklist to make the call efficient. If helpful, we can split the session into 30m network/30m deployment plan.

Looking forward —
Jasmine

--
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555‑0127
Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme_discovery_notes.pdf (notes, 3 pages); redwood_privdeploy_prereq_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmebio.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@acmebio.com>, AcmeBio IT <it-security@acmebio.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post‑discovery: proposing an on‑prem ops & VPC architecture session

Thanks Jasmine — great summary. Rajesh and I reviewed the notes and the checklist looks good. Our ops lead (CC'd) needs to be present; she has a thin calendar next week. Of your proposed windows the only feasible slot is Fri Jul 17 09:00–10:00 PST. Could you confirm Connor will cover network peering and Jordan can speak to costing/throughput expectations?

Two quick items from our side before the session:
- We use AWS KMS; we're looking at bringing our own key material (BYOK) for production.
- Our network team needs to see a sample firewall rule set and the expected outbound domains for telemetry.

We can also do a 30/30 split as you suggested. Please send a calendar invite and any short pre‑reads.

Best,
Samantha

--
Samantha Li
Head of IT Infrastructure, AcmeBio
samantha.li@acmebio.com | +1 (617) 555‑0987

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmebio.com>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@acmebio.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post‑discovery: proposing an on‑prem ops & VPC architecture session

Great — Fri Jul 17 09:00–10:00 PST is locked. I sent a calendar invite titled "AcmeBio — Private/VPC Ops & Architecture Review" (you should see it in your inbox). Connor will lead the network/peering portion and Jordan will cover deployment sizing, throughput targets, and an initial cost band for Dedicated vs. Private POC.

Precall items (what we'll bring):
- Connor: sample firewall/IP rule set, NAT/eBPF notes, and a diagram of peering options
- Jordan: throughput profiles for genomics batch workloads, rough cost delta estimates, and fallback model routing strategy
- Me: discovery notes and a short runbook we can iterate on during the call

Precall asks for AcmeBio (please send before Fri 08:00 PST):
- VPC CIDR(s) and expected public/private subnets
- KMS provider confirmation including any BYOK constraints
- Any egress/proxy requirements that would block outbound telemetry

Link to materials: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C_acme-discovery (I added the checklist and a network template).

If your ops lead can't open the invite, ping me and I can produce an ICS. See you Friday.

-Jasmine

Thanks — looking forward.
